chat.waitingForEnd: Please wait for the current conversation to end
chat.toolsActive: This chat will send {{count}} tools. You will still be asked before each call.

toolsGate.switchOff: A server can show as connected in Settings, but Give tools to the current model is still off. This chat will not send tools.
toolsGate.modelPending: Checking whether this model reports the tools capability. Until that is known, this chat will not send tools. Connected in Settings only means the server is up.
toolsGate.modelUnknown: This model's tools capability could not be confirmed. This chat will not send tools. Connected in Settings only means the server is up.
toolsGate.modelUnsupported: This model is confirmed to have no tools capability, so this chat will not send tools to it. Connected in Settings only means the server is up, not that the model can call tools.
toolsGate.noTools: The switch is on and this model supports tools, but no connected tool is available. This chat will not send tools.

mcpSetting.title: Tools / MCP
mcpSetting.storageNotice: These values stay in local extension storage only. Extension storage is not a secret vault.
mcpSetting.authRequired: Sign-in required. This version only supports request headers filled in ahead of time.
mcpSetting.stdioOnly: This version only supports Streamable HTTP.
mcpSetting.toolsEnabled: Give tools to the current model
mcpSetting.toolsEnabledExtra: While off, requests omit tools. Only a model that explicitly reports the tools capability receives them.
mcpSetting.toolCap: More than {{count}} tools are connected. The local model only sees the first {{count}}.
mcpSetting.jsonHelp: This version only connects to a Streamable HTTP url. command, args, env, and cwd (stdio), a legacy HTTP+SSE type or transport of sse, and oauth are rejected and are not dropped silently. A successful POST /mcp response may itself be text/event-stream; that is a normal Streamable HTTP body, so do not set type to "sse" because of it. Kept fields: url, headers (names to strings), enabled, timeout (seconds), description, and rewriteOrigin. When rewriteOrigin is omitted, 127.0.0.1, localhost, and [::1] rewrite Origin by default, and remote addresses do not. Headers stay in local extension storage only. They are not synced and are not written to logs.
mcpSetting.jsonExamples: Checked public read-only examples, not web search: DeepWiki for public repositories at https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp ; Context7 for library docs at https://mcp.context7.com/mcp . https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp can initialize and list tools without a key, but web_search_exa may return 429 when the shared quota is exhausted, so it is not guaranteed.
mcpSetting.jsonRejected: This JSON was not saved. The previous configuration is unchanged.
mcpSetting.jsonSaved: Saved. An open chat side panel reconnects from it.
mcpSetting.connectionIsNotChat: Connected here only means the server is up. It does not mean this chat will send tools to the model. That depends on the switch and the model's tools capability. You are still asked before a call.
mcpSetting.issueJson: The JSON could not be parsed.
mcpSetting.issueShape: Use an object like {"mcpServers":{"name":{"url":"https://.../mcp"}}}. An older server array is also accepted.
mcpSetting.issueName: The name {{server}} must be letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, and it must match the key.
mcpSetting.issueStdio: {{server}} uses {{detail}}. This version does not launch stdio.
mcpSetting.issueSse: {{server}} uses the legacy SSE transport. Keep only the Streamable HTTP url. A text/event-stream response does not need type: "sse".
mcpSetting.issueOauth: {{server}} includes oauth. This version does not support OAuth. Put a token in headers instead.
mcpSetting.issueUnsupported: {{server}} includes fields this version does not support: {{detail}}

ollamaSetting.keepAliveExtra: Controls how long the model stays in memory after a request (default: 5 minutes).
ollamaSetting.temperatureExtra: Model temperature. Increasing temperature makes responses more creative (default: 0.8).
ollamaSetting.numCtxExtra: Sets the context window size for generating the next token (default: 2048).
ollamaSetting.numPredictExtra: Maximum tokens to predict when generating text (default: -1 means unlimited generation).

customModel.title: Custom models
customModel.description: Configure the endpoint and key once per service, then add as many models as you need. Supports OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Claude Messages. API keys stay on this device and are not synced with your account.
customModel.urlExtra: Full endpoint URL. The protocol is detected from the path.
customModel.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
customModel.testNeedFields: Enter a valid URL and model name first
customModel.testOk: Connected ({{count}} models). Slowest first response: {{ms}} ms
customModel.modelRequired: Enter at least one model name
customModel.sessionHeadersExtra: Sends X-Session-Id, X-QA-Id and X-Model-Request-Id headers plus prompt_cache_key for session affinity and cache hits. Leave off if the service does not support them.
customModel.deleteConfirm: Delete service {{name}} and all its models?
customModel.listHint: Click a model name to switch to it
customModel.modelNameExtra: Press Enter to add more than one. Once the URL and key are filled in, you can pick from the service's model list.
customModel.sharedHint: These settings apply to every model of this service. Add models with different capabilities separately.
